subject.title: [Feature]: Merge iOS Privacy and Location card state

question: Should Settings > Privacy adopt the single Location card model from https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/103096, with Access Level remaining selectable for While Using versus Always?
rationale: The duplicate card state is source-proven, but replacing the three-way picker with a switch/value-row model changes a visible privacy-control contract and needs iOS/product owner intent before merge.

options.title: Approve repaired single-card model
options.body: Land the linked PR only after it keeps Location as the single state owner, preserves an in-app Always selection path, and syncs focused tests/i18n.

options.title: Keep the current picker for now
options.body: Leave the issue open or close the PR if maintainers prefer the existing Off/While Using/Always segmented control until a broader iOS privacy redesign is chosen.

options.title: Defer to broader location posture work
options.body: Track only the Always/background-location policy in the broader location issues and explicitly leave this duplicate-card cleanup unresolved for now.

recommendation.title: Approve repaired single-card model
recommendation.body: Land the linked PR only after it keeps Location as the single state owner, preserves an in-app Always selection path, and syncs focused tests/i18n.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged work and merge ownership on the same iOS Privacy and Location settings surfaces make this the strongest available routing candidate.
